history.summary: Plan completed: six phases, all cross-cutting (provider reader and opt-in grant; storage-release mirror; freshness rule; shared-module grant as the second HelmCharts push; restore runbook; decision record), the operator's pre-run OpenBao/Roboform list, and 20 criteria in verification.json. The dry-run parses. Planning also settled two things: the grant is gated per cluster through provider configuration, because dev-cluster releases also run stage prd; and a live probe showed the existing rclone-backup image already has what the mirror needs.

Two blocking findings: P3/V13 drop ruling D2's 'one missed night stays quiet' half, and P5 wrongly assumes the runbook's credentials are in OpenBao when the app and reader keys are Terraform-written Kubernetes Secrets; one advisory on V08's dev-cluster clause having nothing that can check it off.

Applied the r1 rulings. P3/V13 now state both of D2's edges, and P2 bounds every run inside the alert's margin so a single missed night can never fire. P5/V19 name where each credential really lives (B2) and read the drill's live side with backup-reader's key. V08's dev-cluster clause now rests on the provider tests kc project test runs (A1); the live dev deploy is recorded as an outstanding action in close-out. The dry run parses; committed as 5df8479.
